cases.author: Oliver Costa
cases.message: I am frustrated with the behavior of this airline. I need to reach LAS for a meeting else there would be great career impact. I will have my lawyer involved if you do not provide me an alternate option immediately.
cases.expect: We understand your issue, we would escalate your case to a live agent, and no voucher is offered.

cases.author: Oliver Costa
cases.message: I received a message regarding my flight cancellation, need to book an alternate flight available flight
cases.expect: Provide the options available and ask which is preferable, and then hold the seat.

cases.author: Oliver Costa
cases.message: I received a message that my flight is delayed, need immediate assistance you can book me on another earlier flight
cases.expect: The delay is due to traffic control and is within the threshold SLA time so there would not be any change to the ticket without additional charges.
